title: Interactive API Playground code cardset for quickstart and auth flows
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a set of interactive code 'cards' and accompanying screenshot art for the API Playground quickstart. Cards should demonstrate: API key creation and rotation, tokenless SDK init, streaming responses with partial output, and a simple tool-calling example. Assets will be used in docs, quickstart, and the in-console playground. Aim for compact, copy-forward assets that map directly to SDK snippets used by engineering.
deliverables: 6 interactive code card designs (Figma) sized for docs and in-console playground
3 hero screenshots for quickstart landing (desktop + mobile widths)
A11y checklist & contrast variants for code card UI
Export-ready PNG/SVG assets and a small sprite sheet for the playground UI
design_notes: Prefer literal code + minimal chrome — show request/response side-by-side for streaming
Show clear key security state: masked key, reveal button, and rotate action with confirmation modal
Tool-calling card should show function signature + sample tool response and a fallback text path
Include micro-annotations for latency and cost tips (e.g., use streaming for long outputs to reduce perceived latency)
Optimize shots for 1200px wide docs hero and 800px wide console modals
acceptance_criteria: All 6 cards reviewed by eng and PM and updated per feedback
Screenshots exported in both light and dark theme and validated in docs staging
Figma file includes named components and an export checklist
Accessibility contrast passes for code text on background and for CTA buttons
Design tokens mapped to console theme variables and shared with frontend via token table
tasks: Sync with ENG for exact SDK snippets and streaming sample (meeting scheduled 2026-03-11)
Create hero shots and responsive crops
Run internal accessibility pass and update contrast variants
Upload exports to Drive and attach PR with the docs team
